product.name: 1800 Series Servo Pattern Plate (For Standard Size Servos)

warnings: Sizes come from the printed drawing: 104 mm length, 40 mm width, 3 mm thickness, 8 mm grid, Ø4 mm holes, Ø14 mm bore, and a 42 x 21 mm pocket. The origin is the plate center, with x along the 104 mm length. The Ø14 mm bore is at the right end. Hole coordinates were scaled from the drawing pixels and snapped to the 8 mm grid, so they are approximate. The pocket center is estimated at about x=-26, y=0. The four tapped holes are at x=-50 and x=-2, y=±5, which gives about 48 mm by 10 mm spacing. They are listed as Ø4 mm and assumed through, which is not confirmed. Vertical slots at x=32, y=±16, horizontal slots near (17,0) and (46,0), short oblong holes near (24,8) and (40,-8), and a small slot at the left end of the pocket are not listed in holes because their exact sizes are not printed. The left-end profile has a rounded bump, and the pocket has corner relief notches. Neither is modeled. Servo spline offset (48 mm) is from the text and not modeled.
Slots (vertical at x=32,y=±16, horizontal near x=18 and x=46 on the centerline) and the oblong holes near (24,8) and (40,-8) are omitted because their lengths are not dimensioned.
The rounded bump on the left end and the pocket corner relief notches are not modeled.
The four M4 holes beside the pocket are modeled as plain Ø4 mm through holes with no threads, and their positions are approximate.
The hole layout was read from the drawing and snapped to the 8 mm grid, so some positions may be slightly off.
The plate lies in the XY plane because the given bounds are x=104, y=40, z=3. The Y offset of +20 puts the bottom edge at Y=0.
